entry_state: The operating-company methods retain cost histories, subsequent events, tax origins and dated authority. ASBE transition requires both opening and comparative effects. Ping An's adoption balances constrain a history without identifying an equity plug, later payments or a discount rate. Financing, ownership and the group boundary are the next accounting questions.
exit_state: Debt balances, cash repayments and risk sensitivities measure different quantities; net borrowing can conceal intraperiod funding. Ownership adds dated share quantities. The split-adjusted basic denominator is established, and potential-share attribution has begun with options and a coupon-bearing convertible; its dilution calculation continues.
